query:
SELECT 
  u.id,
  u.email,
  u.name,
  u.creditsPurchased,
  u.creditsSubscription,
  u.creditsResetDate,
  s.plan,
  s.status
FROM users u
INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON u.id = s.userId
WHERE u.email IN ('lingmoyuan@sina.com', '1558328644@qq.com');
